name: nevo-specflow
description: Workspace root for Nevo SpecFlow — a spec-driven development framework for AI-assisted software engineering.

scripts.format:check: prettier --write docs/ideas/roadmap.md docs/ideas/roadmap-coverage.md tools/docs/src/domain/markdown-tables.ts tools/docs/test/domain/markdown-tables.test.ts && git diff -- docs/ideas/roadmap.md docs/ideas/roadmap-coverage.md tools/docs/src/domain/markdown-tables.ts tools/docs/test/domain/markdown-tables.test.ts && prettier --check .
scripts.prepare: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('git config core.hooksPath .githooks', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch {}"
scripts.check:quality: pnpm quality:build-prerequisites && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js check && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js check && pnpm version:check-transition
scripts.check: pnpm check:quality && turbo run typecheck && turbo run build && turbo run test
scripts.agents:build: pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter nevo-repo-agents build && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js build
scripts.agents:check: pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter nevo-repo-agents build && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js check
scripts.docs:list: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js list
scripts.docs:find: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js find
scripts.docs:get: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js get
scripts.docs:context: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js context
scripts.docs:check: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js check
scripts.docs:search: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js search
scripts.docs:semantic: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js semantic
scripts.docs:eval: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js eval
scripts.docs:adr: turbo run build --filter=nevo-repo-docs --output-logs=errors-only 1>&2 && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js adr
scripts.storybook:browsers:install: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-storybook exec playwright install chromium
